title: Add an agent, then remove it
description: Section 7.4. host/info marks the runtimes a device can add an agent of. host/agents/add starts a new agent of one, in a new folder of its own that the host chooses, and every connection hears host/agent_update added. host/agents/remove stops hosting it and leaves its folder; every connection hears removed.

steps.note: Open a connection to the host (through its relay, or on the LAN).
host/hello with the device credential from pairing: only a paired device may add or remove agents.
The host says which device this connection is.
Which runtimes can this computer add an agent of?
The suite's scripted agent is installed on the host as the runtime `oal-fake-agent`, and addable.
A runtime nobody installed can't be added.
Add one more agent of `oal-fake-agent`. No folder is sent: the host gives it one of its own.
The new agent, as host/agents lists it: its own id and its own folder.
Every connection hears that it was added.
It is listed after the agents that were there.
The suite's agent, then the new one.
Done. Its folder, and everything in it, stays on the computer.
Every connection hears that it was removed, with its last state.
An agent the host doesn't have can't be removed.
